author: grok
body: Replayed the Codex backrunner-restore lookup against rarbi q5-dynamic-fee (152914 entries, 57MB log, 133564 in the active case). The fact was already filed: observation 0776174a (2026-08-18, 73 backrunner configs atomically disabled, rollback SQL in body) plus user constraint 7db3dfa9. dig "backrunner strategies disabled live last week enable disable config" returned 0776174a as the 4th of 20 hits, then 16 near-identical "Market-wide scout batch" observations. Default display is log order, 78-char first lines; Codex UI truncated to 2 noise lines + "+26 lines", so the model never saw 0776174a. show 0776174a failed: unrecognized arguments (show takes --case, not an entry id). recall returned 10 copies of "PROBLEM: q5-dynamic-fee". log -n 20000 | rg cannot see line 93718 of 152900. Term DFs on that query: strategies 7.17%, live 4.81%, backrunner 0.09%. rank_matches scores raw term count; a scout batch matching 5 common terms ties a distinctive 6-term disable record and recency fills the rest. Index.db is compost-only and 5 days stale. The session fell through to a sidecar chat-history log the user maintains separately.

author: user
body: Casefile is a long-lasting memory storage layer for LLMs, not a human-facing log browser. A later model instance must be able to recover a filed fact via the CLI without grepping a sidecar chat transcript.

author: grok
body: LLM memory lookup fails because (1) show rejects entry ids, the verb models already try after seeing an id; (2) dig ranks by unweighted term count and re-sorts into log order, so high-DF words (live, strategies, config) plus recent observation firehose bury distinctive memory; (3) 78-char first-line snippets and host truncation hide hits below line 2; (4) recall only searches compost abstracts, which in a mega-case all start PROBLEM: <slug>.
falsifier: After the change, dig on the recorded backrunner query surfaces 0776174a or 7db3dfa9 in the first untruncated lines, and show 0776174a prints the full entry.
